simple.meaning: מְעָרָה (mᵉʻârâh) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a cavern (as dark).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 19:30. The surrounding context includes family line, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְעָרָה (H4631) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H4631. mearah מְעָרָה 40 noun feminine cave ; — absolute ׳מ Gen 19:30 +; construct מְעָרַת 23:19 +; plural מְעָרוֺת Judg 6:2 +, construct id. Isa 2:19 ; — cave , especially as place of sojourn or refuge Gen 19:30 (J), 1Sam 24:3 (twice in verse); 24:7 ; 24:8 ; 24:10 (Ginsb; v. 24:4 ; v. 24:8 ; v. 24:9 ; v. 24:11 van d. H. Bear), 1Kin 19:1 , 13 ; Ezek 33:27 ; Josh 10:16 ( ׳מ בַמַּקֵּדָה ) + 7 t. Joshua 10; Judg 6:2 ; 1Sam 13:6 ; 1Kin 18:4 , 13 , compare Psa 57:1 ; 142:1 ; צֻרִים מְעָרוֺת Isa 2:19 , hence ׳מ מָּרִצִים Jer 7:11 robbers' cave ; Isa 32:14 den (of wild beasts); — ׳מ עֲדֻלָּם 1Sam 22:1 ; 2Sam 23:13 , whence in || 1Chr 11:15 , read probably ע ׳מְצֻדַת or מְצָדַת We, compare Dr, Bu Kit HPS; — as burial place, ׳מ הַמַּכְמֵּלָה Gen 23:9 + (see מַכְמֵּלָה ) = ׳מ alone 23:11 , 17 , 20 ; 49:29 , 32 (all P). ׳מ לַצִּידֹנִים אֲשֶׁר Josh 13:4 (D), cave-region in Lebanon east of Sidon, modern Mughâr Gezzîn , according to most, but dubious; perhaps, rather, near Tyre Buhl MDPV 1895, 55 .
